app.name: Little Alchemy 2
app.long_description:
Start with water, fire, earth and air. Point with the Wii Remote, drag one element onto another and see what you create. All 720 elements and recipes of Little Alchemy 2 to discover.
A: drag (double-press A to copy) B: remove the element under the pointer -: clear the table 1: hint 2: hide finished elements +: menu HOME: exit Also plays with the Nunchuk, Classic Controller, GameCube controller, Wii U GamePad, Wii U Pro Controller, DualShock 3, USB mouse and USB keyboard.
Progress is saved to the SD card.
